text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Dear Mom and Dad, It looks like my popularity melted away with the snow. The crowds were a teensy bit quiet at today's race.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: But I wasn't gonna let that get me down! I already decided that if I was gonna get popular, I wanted it to be on my terms!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: But right when I got myself all motivated, I saw that one Umamusume (you know the one) looking all sad. I just had to do something…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I know she's my rival and everything, but I told her I was cheer'n for her, and that I wanted to see her shine like a star again!
